_: The storyteller's pace (director.js; Left 4 Dead's director, CK3's pushback). tension: 0 calm to 1 the realm on fire (wars between the houses, towns rioting or starving, a usurper, the threat itself). After quietSeasons seasons under quietBelow, one threat rises at a place and grows by its grow each season until the King answers it there (an order in answers, at one of its towns) or it breaks at 1. After it passes or breaks, breather seasons of rest. says: what the realm reports as it grows (by level), {house} {town} {n}; answers: the orders that answer it at its place, each in proportion (no cheap gesture dissolves a threat): ends ends it; delay buys that many seasons (bigDelay against a host of 6 companies or more), and the lord remembers it; ease takes that much off it, and it ends only if that brings it to nothing before it lands; anywhere: given at Kingsmere (the banners, the levy), not at the place; toHouse: given to the threat's house (a grant), wherever the town. pushback: a King too comfortable (peace, purse in gold, the houses' mean favour all at or over these) draws envy every few seasons: the strongest other house cools by envy and a threat comes sooner.

says: {house}'s host at {town} grows: {n} companies under arms
{house}'s host at {town} is ready to march
host.broke: {house}'s host marches out of {town}, against the crown's towns
host.why: An army does not gather for nothing. Answer it now, at {town}, or it marches.

feast.label: Feast them, and buy a season

banners.label: Call the banners to match their host

levy.label: Raise the royal levy to match their host

march.label: Break the host before it marches

says: {town} is starving, and the hunger reaches its neighbours
famine.passed: The King's grain reaches {town}, and the hunger eases
famine.why: A hungry town shrinks, riots and blames its King. Grain now costs less than a rising later.

relief.label: Send grain from the royal stores

says: Banners that are not the King's are seen at {town}
At {town}, {house} speaks of a better claim to the throne
pretender.broke: {house} proclaims a pretender at {town}; every house is asked to choose
pretender.passed: The pretender's banners at {town} come down
pretender.why: A claim left unanswered gathers friends. Bind {house} to the crown, or shame them.

grant.label: Grant them land to quiet the claim

marriage.label: Wed the claim into the crown's line

ward.label: Take their heir as a royal ward

march.label: Put down the claim by force
